messages:
liam-support: Hey team — customer (acct: acme-inc) reports invoice shows 1.2M tokens billed but our served-tokens dashboard shows ~900k. They included examples and are upset. Invoice ID INV-2026-0582.
anya-billing: thanks liam. Any obvious audit logs we can hand to them?
liam-support: pasted one request example from their logs: 
```
request_id=rcq_9b2f
model=gpt-4o-redwood
prefetch=enabled
continuous_batcher=enabled
served_tokens=512
billed_tokens=768
```

kyle-eng: that pattern (served < billed) typically shows up when prefetch/KV cache does extra token accounting during continuous batch warmup. We had a patch last quarter that changed how the reconciler attributes prefetched tokens across shards.
maria-telemetry: pulling traces for that request_id now. quick check: our metering pipeline stores two token events: served_token_event and prefetch_charge_event. If they weren't coalesced before invoice generation, billing could double-count.
liam-support: customer says this is across dozens of requests, not just one. Their usage spike aligned with a rollout last week.
kyle-eng: can you confirm whether this tenant was on the new shard-reconciler config? There was a migration that flips on per-shard attribution; if the migrator failed halfway the reconciler might have emitted both per-shard and global prefetch charges.
maria-telemetry: grab this trace snippet: 
```
2026-03-12T15:04:12Z TRACE start request rcq_9b2f
2026-03-12T15:04:12Z DEBUG prefetch_dispatch shard=3 tokens=256 event_id=prefetch_47
2026-03-12T15:04:12Z DEBUG prefetch_dispatch shard=7 tokens=256 event_id=prefetch_48
2026-03-12T15:04:12Z INFO reconciler emitted charge_id=ch_501 type=prefetch tokens=512
2026-03-12T15:04:12Z INFO metering emitted charge_id=ch_502 type=served tokens=512
2026-03-12T15:04:12Z INFO invoice pipeline observed both ch_501,ch_502 -> billed 1024
```

kyle-eng: looks like two separate prefetch events plus a served event — reconciler should collapse related prefetch events into a single attribution and mark them as non-billable when served coincides. Something in the migration toggles that logic.
anya-billing: customer wants a credit. Before we act, can we reproduce on staging and confirm which pipeline produced the extra event? Also need exact invoice lines to adjust.
liam-support: I asked for the invoice line items and sent to anya.
maria-telemetry: I've queued a backfill to recompute charges for that tenant for 2026-03-12..15. ETA ~90m. I also kicked a staging run with the old reconciler flag to compare outputs.
kyle-eng: steps to repro (from my notes): 
1) enable continuous_batcher + kv_prefetch on a single multi-shard model
2) fire ~200 short requests that hit prefix cache warmup
3) run metering ingest and invoice aggregation
expected: billed ~= served +/- tiny margin; current-bug: billed > served by ~30%

I'll try to reproduce with the exact request shapes.
liam-support: customer asked for interim mitigation — can we temporarily disable prefetch for that tenant?
kyle-eng: yes, we can flip a tenant flag to disable kv_prefetch for prod for acme-inc. That avoids warmup prefetch charges. Will require a deploy to gate the flag.
anya-billing: go ahead with the tenant flag toggle and pause automatic invoice generation for the affected billing period until backfill completes. I'll open a billing adjustment hold.
liam-support: done — sent customer a note: "we're investigating, temporary mitigation applied, you will not be billed while we reconcile." They replied :thumbsup:.
maria-telemetry: backfill job finished; preliminary results: recomputed billed tokens for tenant down to 905k (matches served within noise). Saving full diff and creating ticket.
kyle-eng: created GH issue redwood/reconciler#458: root cause is double-emission of prefetch charge during shard-reconciler migration when both global and per-shard paths were enabled. Patch ready to remove global fallback.
anya-billing: opened INC-2149 for customer credit and hold release when patch lands.
liam-support: closing loop with customer now. Thanks all.
billing-bot: Invoice INV-2026-0582 status: adjustment_pending (hold placed by anya-billing).
liam-support: filing postmortem checklist for the migration rollout to avoid future partial migrations.
